purpose: Single machine-readable source of truth for public claims. facts-gate.mjs enforces it.

status_vocabulary.live: Shipped and observable by a stranger today. Quotable in present tense.

status_vocabulary.planned: Code may exist; nothing is live. Only describable in future/conditional tense.
status_vocabulary.retired: Was live, is not. Only describable in past tense.
status_vocabulary.internal: Real internally, NOT a public claim. Must never appear in public copy as fact.

axis_count.grammar_warning: The two numbers mean different things and BOTH must travel. 22 counts SLOTS on the board; 15 counts slots with a measurement behind them. Claiming the larger number as measured would assert 7 measurements that do not exist. Quote the sentence, or quote the smaller number.

doctrine_verbatim: We measure, we sign, we re-attest.
We do NOT certify, accredit, enforce, endorse, or tokenize.
Not a certification body, not a notified body.
No money from anything we rank.
Verification is free forever; a grade is never sold.

negation_forms_that_must_pass: we do not certify, accredit or approve anything
It attests training, not conformity — we certify nothing
we measure, we do not certify
nothing here is a conformity assessment
boundary.gate_note: The negation forms above are LOAD-BEARING TEST CASES, verified present on the live site 2026-08-26. 'we certify nothing' is a negation-by-object and is the form most likely to be mis-flagged. A gate that fails any of these is over-broad and will be disabled — which is how this class of gate died before.
